ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Bureaucratic Politics. This course examines the origin of public agencies, the nature of public management, the behavior of individual bureaucrats and the procedures used by the U.S. Federal bureaucracy. It also lays a theoretical foundation for why politicians delegate authority to bureaucracies and why bureaucratic actions may diverge from politicians? expectations.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
